text.en: Targets under the effects of Judgment long enough are struck with a burst of damage.
Maintaining the Vex Cage for 3.75 seconds creates a burst of <pve 1060 /> <pvp [520] /> damage to targets within it. Timer increases to 4 seconds after the first burst of damage.
Maintaining the Vex Cage for 3.75 seconds creates a burst of <pve 1060 /> <pvp [520] /> damage to targets within it. Timer increases to 3 seconds after the first burst of damage.
